notes.title: Development Live Stream
notes.content: Lana Lux, creator of STRAIN will be working on the game during this live stream.

notes.title: Watch live updates on Twitch
notes.content:
Hello. I'm Lana Lux, the creator of STRAIN. I stream the development process daily on Twitch. If you're curious to see the status of the game or see how it's made, come on by. You can find it here:

https://www.twitch.tv/lana_lux

You can also check out the docuseries about the game here: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgDims6vGDE&list=PL0zTFuiPMZYrg0QvDriHrGVLezcjv5v0K&ab_channel=LanaLux
